question: In March 2025, India hosted the inaugural edition of which naval exercise aimed at enhancing maritime cooperation with African nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Africa-India Key Maritime Engagement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Africa-India Key Maritime Engagement** was held in **March 2025**, marking the inaugural edition of this naval exercise.
 
• This exercise was specifically aimed at enhancing **maritime cooperation** between **India and African nations**.
 
• It reflects India’s ongoing efforts to strengthen **security partnerships** in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)** and bolster ties with **African countries**.
